data.narrative:
DigiChem is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Greg Ellson and Ben Berman that has raised $4M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector universe comprising 1 public comparable (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable valuation approach here. Using the $4M total raised as a proxy for base value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, this method implies a $10M valuation. The Peer-Median approach was not viable; while 11 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters for stage, timing, and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3) to support a reliable median benchmark.

This analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $12M, with a median point of $10M. The range reflects reasonable variance around the single applicable method rather than triangulation across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently granular peer comparables at Seed stage within robotics and manufacturing, and limited visibility into DigiChem's specific operational metrics relative to the broader peer set. A more refined valuation would require either additional Seed-stage comparables or forward-looking revenue and margin assumptions.
